GroupedSelector is a rail of collapsible groups with a boxed count on each header and selectable rows.
It is built for the current step in a sequential workflow, driven by data updates (animated), with steps either side of DOING.
A bell trigger with a count badge opening an inbox panel of notification rows with action buttons.
SVG DAG with dagre-computed automatic layout of nodes and edges.
Pivots tagged rows on two string-tag dimensions into a Treemap with a SlotFillBar per bucket.
Its entry describes a grid of status-coloured full/partial/missing cells with row and column labels.
Radial donut gauge for N of total completion gauges.

why: Fluid left list, centre detail and right context panels, with asides stacking at phone widths.
WeekCalendar is a weekly time grid, not a month grid with events per day cell.
Sidebar has a draggable resize edge but is a side column, not a split pane between two panels.
DateRangePicker has private time inputs but is a range picker with presets, not a single date-and-time-of-day picker; DatePicker is date-only.
RingChart is a donut gauge but has no avatar in the centre.
